comments.author: Yihwa
comments.body:
This quest's adventure requirement is generally accepted to be 16000.

Don't give up if you don't pull it even with the right skill ranks. It took me about a hundred QMPs to pull this. If you want to narrow it down, select East coast of South America as the destination when you pull it.

Note: This is the first quest in the chain leading to Magellan's Log, the +2 Geography accessory with an effect.
